summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a material change: its partnership Smackover Lithium entered an EPCM agreement with Wood Group USA for the upstream well field of the South West Arkansas Project. The filing describes a routine project development milestone, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The agreement covers engineering, procurement, and construction management services; a final investment decision is expected later in 2026. This is an operational update, not a corporate event requiring special-situation classification.
